commands.name: crew
commands.description: Show or hide the crew panel: every subagent of this session, and the files read, changed and committed

commands.name: crew-settings
commands.description: Open the crew panel settings: usage, timeline, totals, notifications, language

children: Context and limits at the top of the panel; the Usage group picks which
Main chat and subagents apart, with tokens and a total
Running and finished subagents, with details
When each agent ran, on one shared axis
A row at the top: when the main chat worked
Files read, changed and committed, as a tree with diffs
How full the session’s context window is
Use so far and time until it resets
Use so far and time until it resets
Running, finished and failed subagents and conflicts, above the prompt
Each running subagent with its bar, above the prompt
Context and limits with the time until they reset, above the prompt
How many subagents run, in Claude Code’s status line
The panel opens when the first subagent of a session starts
The panel opens when a file is first read or changed in a session
Automatic follows Claude Code’s language, then the system
Smooth: on the desktop the panel redraws four times a second while an agent runs. Light: once a second, and the crabs’ step starts over each time
When a notice comes as a subagent ends
Inside Claude Code, or as the terminal’s or system’s notification
At 80 % and 95 % of a limit, and at 85 % context
When two agents change the same file within 10 minutes
Look once a day for a new version of agent-crew, and say so
The same values as /config. Changes apply at once.
